mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, permission_type, code, name, route_path, component, api_method, api_path, icon, sort, visible, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort, id

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_type, p.code, p.name, p.route_path, p.component, p.api_method, p.api_path, p.icon, p.sort, p.visible, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_admin_role ar ON ar.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
SELECT id, parent_id, permission_type, code, name, route_path, component, api_method, api_path, icon, sort, visible, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, parent_id, permission_type, code, name, route_path, component, api_method, api_path, icon, sort, visible, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id}
